scripts.build: npm run build -w @tali/treasury-sui && npm run build -w @tali/shared && npm run build -w @tali/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tali/treasury-sui && npm run build -w @tali/shared && npm run dev -w @tali/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @tali/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tali/treasury-sui && npm run typecheck -w @tali/treasury-sui && npm run typecheck -w @tali/shared && npm run build -w @tali/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tali/web
